info.name: TrashIt API
info.description: Complete API documentation for TrashIt backend - Authentication and Posts

request.description:
### Endpoint
POST /api/auth/register

### Authentication
Not required

### Request Body
```json
{
    "username": "johndoe",
    "name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@test.com",
    "password": "password123"
}
```

### Successful Response (201)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "User registered successfully",
    "token": "eyJhbGci...",
    "user": {
        "_id": "...",
        "username": "johndoe",
        "name": "John Doe",
        "email": "john@test.com",
        "role": "user"
    }
}
```

### Error Responses
- 400: Missing fields
- 400: Email or username already exists

### Endpoint
POST /api/auth/login

### Authentication
Not required

### Request Body
```json
{
    "email": "john@test.com",
    "password": "password123"
}
```

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Login successful",
    "token": "eyJhbGci...",
    "user": {
        "_id": "...",
        "username": "johndoe",
        "name": "John Doe",
        "email": "john@test.com",
        "role": "user"
    }
}
```

### Error Responses
- 400: Missing email or password
- 401: Invalid email or password

**Tip:** Copy the token and set it as the `token` collection variable.

### Endpoint
GET /api/auth/me

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### Headers
```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "user": {
        "_id": "...",
        "username": "johndoe",
        "name": "John Doe",
        "email": "john@test.com",
        "role": "user",
        "createdAt": "...",
        "updatedAt": "..."
    }
}
```

### Error Responses
- 401: No token provided
- 401: Invalid token

### Endpoint
POST /api/posts

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### Request Body (Fixed price & quantity)
```json
{
    "title": "Plastic Bottles",
    "description": "Clean plastic bottles for recycling",
    "type": "sell",
    "price": { "fixed": 500 },
    "quantity": { "fixed": 10 }
}
```

### Request Body (Price range)
```json
{
    "title": "Plastic Bottles",
    "description": "Clean plastic bottles",
    "type": "sell",
    "price": { "min": 400, "max": 600 },
    "quantity": { "min": 5, "max": 20 }
}
```

### Successful Response (201)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Post created successfully",
    "post": {
        "_id": "...",
        "title": "Plastic Bottles",
        "description": "Clean plastic bottles for recycling",
        "images": [],
        "type": "sell",
        "price": { "fixed": 500 },
        "quantity": { "fixed": 10 },
        "status": "active",
        "user": {
            "_id": "...",
            "username": "johndoe",
            "name": "John Doe",
            "email": "john@test.com"
        },
        "createdAt": "...",
        "updatedAt": "..."
    }
}
```

### Error Responses
- 400: Missing required fields
- 400: Validation error (e.g., min > max)
- 401: No token provided

### Endpoint
POST /api/posts

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### Request Body
```json
{
    "title": "Looking for Cardboard",
    "description": "Need cardboard boxes for moving",
    "type": "buy",
    "price": { "min": 200, "max": 400 },
    "quantity": { "min": 5, "max": 15 }
}
```

### Successful Response (201)
Same structure as SELL post, with `type: "buy"`.

### Error Responses
- 400: Missing required fields
- 400: Validation error
- 401: No token provided

### Endpoint
GET /api/posts

### Authentication
Not required

### Query Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| type | string | Filter by `sell` or `buy` |
| status | string | Filter by `active`, `sold`, or `closed` |
| search | string | Search by title or description |
| minPrice | number | Minimum price filter |
| maxPrice | number | Maximum price filter |
| minQuantity | number | Minimum quantity filter |
| maxQuantity | number | Maximum quantity filter |
| sort | string | `newest` or `oldest` |
| page | number | Page number (default: 1) |
| limit | number | Items per page (default: 10, max: 100) |

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "count": 2,
    "total": 2,
    "totalPages": 1,
    "currentPage": 1,
    "posts": [
        { ...post object... },
        { ...post object... }
    ]
}
```

### Endpoint
GET /api/posts?type=sell

### Authentication
Not required

### Query Parameters
- `type`: `sell`

### Successful Response (200)
Returns only posts with `type: "sell"`.

### Endpoint
GET /api/posts?type=buy

### Authentication
Not required

### Query Parameters
- `type`: `buy`

### Successful Response (200)
Returns only posts with `type: "buy"`.

### Endpoint
GET /api/posts?search=plastic

### Authentication
Not required

### Query Parameters
- `search`: Searches in title and description (case-insensitive)

### Successful Response (200)
Returns posts matching the search term.

### Endpoint
GET /api/posts?minPrice=100&maxPrice=600

### Authentication
Not required

### Query Parameters
- `minPrice`: Minimum price
- `maxPrice`: Maximum price

### Successful Response (200)
Returns posts within the price range.

### Endpoint
GET /api/posts?minQuantity=5&maxQuantity=20

### Authentication
Not required

### Query Parameters
- `minQuantity`: Minimum quantity
- `maxQuantity`: Maximum quantity

### Successful Response (200)
Returns posts within the quantity range.

### Endpoint
GET /api/posts?page=1&limit=5

### Authentication
Not required

### Query Parameters
- `page`: Page number (default: 1)
- `limit`: Items per page (default: 10, max: 100)

### Successful Response (200)
Returns paginated results with `total`, `totalPages`, `currentPage`.

### Endpoint
GET /api/posts?sort=oldest

### Authentication
Not required

### Query Parameters
- `sort`: `newest` (default) or `oldest`

### Successful Response (200)
Returns posts sorted by creation date.

### Endpoint
GET /api/posts/:id

### Authentication
Not required

### URL Parameters
- `id`: The post's ObjectId

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "post": { ...post object... }
}
```

### Error Responses
- 400: Invalid post ID
- 404: Post not found

**Tip:** Set the `post_id` collection variable from a previous response.

### Endpoint
PUT /api/posts/:id

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token, owner only)

### Request Body
```json
{
    "title": "Updated Plastic Bottles",
    "price": { "fixed": 550 }
}
```

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Post updated successfully",
    "post": { ...updated post... }
}
```

### Error Responses
- 400: Invalid post ID
- 403: Not the owner
- 404: Post not found

### Endpoint
PATCH /api/posts/:id/status

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token, owner only)

### Request Body
```json
{
    "status": "sold"
}
```

Status values: `active`, `sold`, `closed`

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Post status updated to 'sold'",
    "post": { ...updated post... }
}
```

### Error Responses
- 400: Invalid status value
- 400: Invalid post ID
- 403: Not the owner
- 404: Post not found

### Endpoint
DELETE /api/posts/:id

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token, owner only)

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Post deleted successfully"
}
```

### Error Responses
- 400: Invalid post ID
- 403: Not the owner
- 404: Post not found

### Endpoint
POST /api/favorites/:postId

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### URL Parameters
- `postId`: The post's ObjectId

### Successful Response (201)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Post added to favorites",
    "favorite": {
        "_id": "...",
        "user": "...",
        "post": "...",
        "createdAt": "..."

```

- 400: Invalid post ID
- 401: No token provided
- 404: Post not found

### Endpoint
DELETE /api/favorites/:postId

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### URL Parameters

### Successful Response (200)

### Successful Response (200)
```json

    "success": true,
    "count": 2,
    "favorites": [
        {
            "_id": "...",
            "user": "...",
            "post": {
                "_id": "...",
                "title": "...",
                "type": "sell",
                "status": "active",
                "user": { "username": "...", "name": "..." }
            },

        }
    ]
}
```

### Error Responses

### Endpoint
GET /api/favorites/check/:postId

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### URL Parameters
- `postId`: The post's ObjectId

### Successful Response (200)
```json

    "success": true,

```

### Error Responses
- 400: Invalid post ID
- 401: No token provided

### Endpoint
POST /api/conversations

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### Request Body
```json
{
    "postId": "6aa2c0e68e8018229ce3b931"
}
```

### Successful Response (201)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Conversation created",
    "conversation": {
        "_id": "...",
        "participants": [
            { "_id": "...", "username": "johndoe", "name": "John Doe", "email": "john@test.com" },
            { "_id": "...", "username": "janedoe", "name": "Jane Doe", "email": "jane@test.com" }
        ],
        "post": "...",
        "lastMessage": "",
        "createdAt": "..."
    }
}
```

### Error Responses
- 400: postId is required
- 400: Cannot message yourself
- 404: Post not found
- 401: No token provided

**Tip:** Copy the conversation `_id` for WebSocket testing.

### Endpoint
GET /api/conversations

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "count": 1,
    "conversations": [
        {
            "_id": "...",
            "participants": [...],
            "post": { "_id": "...", "title": "...", "type": "sell", "status": "active" },
            "lastMessage": "Hello!",
            "lastMessageAt": "..."
        }
    ]
}
```

### Endpoint
GET /api/conversations/:id/messages

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token, participants only)

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "count": 2,
    "messages": [
        {
            "_id": "...",
            "conversation": "...",
            "sender": { "_id": "...", "username": "johndoe", "name": "John Doe" },
            "content": "Hello, is this available?",
            "read": false,
            "createdAt": "..."
        }
    ]
}
```

### Error Responses
- 403: Not a participant
- 404: Conversation not found

### Endpoint
GET /api/notifications

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "count": 2,
    "notifications": [
        {
            "_id": "...",
            "recipient": "...",
            "type": "new_conversation",
            "message": "janedoe wants to discuss your post",
            "read": false,
            "sender": { "username": "janedoe" },
            "relatedPost": { "title": "..." },
            "createdAt": "..."
        }
    ]
}
```

### Endpoint
GET /api/notifications/unread-count

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "unreadCount": 3
}
```

### Endpoint
PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Notification marked as read",
    "notification": { ... }
}
```

### Endpoint
PATCH /api/notifications/read-all

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "All notifications marked as read"
}
```

## WebSocket Connection

Connect to the Socket.io server with JWT authentication:

```javascript
const socket = io("http://localhost:5000", {
    auth: {
        token: "your_jwt_token_here"
    }
});
```

## Events (Client -> Server)

### `send_message`
Send a message in a conversation.
```json
{
    "conversationId": "...",
    "content": "Hello, is this available?"
}
```

### `join_conversation`
Join a conversation room to receive real-time messages.
```json
{
    "conversationId": "..."
}
```

### `leave_conversation`
Leave a conversation room.
```json
{
    "conversationId": "..."
}
```

## Events (Server -> Client)

### `new_message`
Received when a new message is sent in a conversation you're part of.
```json
{
    "_id": "...",
    "conversation": "...",
    "sender": { "_id": "...", "username": "...", "name": "..." },
    "content": "Hello!",
    "read": false,
    "createdAt": "..."
}
```

### `new_notification`
Received when a new notification is created for you.
```json
{
    "_id": "...",
    "recipient": "...",
    "type": "new_message",
    "message": "johndoe sent you a message",
    "read": false,
    "sender": "...",
    "relatedPost": "...",
    "relatedConversation": "...",
    "createdAt": "..."
}
```

### `joined_conversation`
Confirmed joining a conversation room.
```json
{
    "conversationId": "..."
}
```

### `left_conversation`
Confirmed leaving a conversation room.
```json
{
    "conversationId": "..."
}
```

### `error`
Error event.
```json
{
    "message": "Error description"
}
```

### Endpoint

{
    "name": "John Updated",

### Endpoint
POST /api/ai/what-could-i-make

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### Request Body
```json
{
    "material": "wine bottles"
}
```

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "material": "wine bottles",
    "ideas": [
        {
            "title": "Wine Bottle Candle Holder",
            "description": "Transform wine bottles into elegant candle holders",
            "steps": ["Clean the bottle", "Cut the top", "Sand the edge", "Insert candle"],
            "difficulty": "easy"
        },
        ...
    ]
}
```

### Error Responses
- 400: Material is required / too long
- 401: No token provided
- 502: AI service unavailable

### Testing
1. Login and copy token
2. Send POST with a material name
3. Get 5 creative ideas back

### Endpoint
GET /api/matches

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token)

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "count": 1,
    "matches": [
        {
            "_id": "...",
            "buyPost": { "_id": "...", "title": "...", "type": "buy", "user": { "username": "..." } },
            "sellPost": { "_id": "...", "title": "...", "type": "sell", "user": { "username": "..." } },
            "buyerNotified": true,
            "sellerNotified": true
        }
    ]
}
```

### Error Responses
- 401: No token provided

### Endpoint
GET /api/matches/:id

### Authentication
Required (Bearer token, participants only)

### URL Parameters
- `id`: The match's ObjectId

### Successful Response (200)
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "match": {
        "_id": "...",
        "buyPost": { "_id": "...", "title": "...", "type": "buy", "price": {}, "quantity": {}, "user": { "username": "...", "name": "...", "email": "..." } },
        "sellPost": { "_id": "...", "title": "...", "type": "sell", "price": {}, "quantity": {}, "user": { "username": "...", "name": "...", "email": "..." } },
        "buyerNotified": true,
        "sellerNotified": true,
        "createdAt": "..."
    }
}
```

### Error Responses
- 400: Invalid match ID
- 403: Not a participant
- 404: Match not found
